bullets: Classic is rebuilt with Material 3 Expressive, with wallpaper colors on Android 12+ and app pages in each app's own icon colors.
Downloads resume after an interruption, keep running in the background, and pause separately from delete.
Install and track several apps that ship from the same repository, grouped together in your Library.
Hand APKs to a third-party installer such as InstallerX, pick your display's refresh rate, and find the fastest mirror from your device.
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) is now available under Tweaks → Language.
App pages open on a release your device can install, and show every platform the project ships.
Explore and Top Charts share one feed, with list or grid layout in Tweaks; Search opens from both.
Background update checks run every 12 hours on Android 12+, with far fewer requests.
Updates are much more accurate: nightly and re-released builds are detected, and an app you already run is no longer offered.
On Desktop, upgrading no longer wipes the app's database.
A cancelled install no longer holds up the next one, and the default installer opens without an "Open with" chooser.
